simple.meaning: שַׁמָּה (shammâh) appears 40 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Deuteronomy, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Psalms, Isaiah, and 7 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:37. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁמָּה (H8047) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שַׁמָּה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.full: H8047. shammah I. שַׁמָּה noun feminine waste, appalment (24 t. Jeremiah); — absolute ׳שׁ Jer 5:30 +; plural absolute שַׁמּוֺת Psa 46:9 ; — 1 a waste , of land, city, etc., Hosea 5:9 ; Isa 5:9 ; 13:9 ; 24:12 ; Zech 7:14 ; Jer 2:15 ; 4:7 ; 18:16 ; 19:8 ; 46:19 ; 48:9 ; 50:3 ; 51:29 , 43 , vine Joel 1:7 ; person Psa 73:19 ; שׁ ׳כּוֺם וּשְׁמָמָה Ezek 23:33 . 2 appalment, horror , i.e. occasion of it; of people land etc., Deut 28:37 ; 2Kin 22:19 ; Micah 6:16 ; Zeph 2:15 ; Jer 5:30 ; 25:9 , 11 , 18 , 38 ; 29:18 ; 44:12 , 22 ; 49:13 , 17 ; 50:23 ; 51:37 , 41 ; 2Chr 29:8 ; 30:7 ; ׳שׁ ׳הֶחֱזִָק֑תְנִ Jer 8:21 .
